import sys

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    
    while m != 0:
        rem = m % w
        if rem == 0 or rem == 1:
            m //= w
        elif rem == w - 1:
            m = (m + 1) // w
        else:
            sys.stdout.write("NO\n")
            return
    sys.stdout.write("YES\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
</translated_code>
